headline: AKS (PROP) flagged with SET clarification and a 12.5σ trading spike remains the day's main risk event.
market_take: Coverage breadth was mixed-to-soft: the 20 most active names averaged a modest decline, dragged by PF (-20.00%) and small-cap CONS weakness (ITD -5.41%, COOK -3.77%). Offsetting positives came from REIT/Property gainers (RABBIT +6.67%, IMPACT +6.3σ, STELLA +4.55%). Unusual-trading alerts concentrated in PF&REIT and PROP names under RM G and T, with several intraday reversals pairing sharp negative opens with positive closes. Five-day movers remain dominated by EMC (+100.0%), EVER (+40.0%) and TTCL (+33.3%), while SOX (CA) (A) sits at -23.5%, XBIO -16.7%, and GEL -20.0% — worth a quick cross-check against the recent XBIO-W6 listing-status termination.

Quiet day: TRUBB -5.17% and STA -3.45% on normal-to-slightly-elevated volume; no alerts.
DCON disclosed a connected-transaction clarification (2026-10-14, high) and SCCC announced a CFO change (2026-10-09); no price action flagged.
